data: In Figure 3(a), what is the approximate value of the red line at Epoch 15?

The red line represents the value of ‖W‖/‖X‖, while the blue line represents the value of ||Xmask||. The y-axis on the left side of the graph shows the values for both lines. At Epoch 15, the red line appears to be around 0.45. Therefore, the approximate value of the red line at Epoch 15 is 0.45.
